scripts.build: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/schema/tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p packages/storage/tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p packages/node-executor/tsconfig.cjs.json && for pkg in schema core storage node-executor; do mkdir -p packages/$pkg/dist/cjs; cp packages/cjs-package.json packages/$pkg/dist/cjs/package.json; done
